rules: Conflict displacement is disabled by default.
When explicitly enabled, exact-slot conflicts are unequipped before restoration.
When the projected two-handed exclusion rule is active, restoring a two-handed item displaces off-hand and shield conflicts.
When the projected two-handed exclusion rule is active, restoring an off-hand or shield item displaces an equipped two-handed conflict.
Conflicts are processed deterministically by slot and runtime instance ID.
Displacement uses ordinary Unequip validation and cannot bypass no_remove or cursed_no_remove restrictions.
The entire resurrection restoration rolls back if displacement or subsequent equipment validation fails.
Displaced instance IDs are returned to the caller for orchestration, audit, and messaging.
